text: Your neighbour's dog barks all night. So you buy earplugs. They work too well. You miss your own wedding. Your fiancée marries the dog. The dog runs for mayor. And wins. First law: Mondays are illegal. The economy collapses. Aliens land to help. They also bark. So you move to the moon. Finally. Silence. Then a rocket lands next door. Your neighbour. With a bigger dog.
